capabilities.spawns_processes: The audit is a pool of external analyzers — ruff, radon, bandit, pip-audit, semgrep and the rest — each run as a subprocess with an argument list, never through a shell. Running them is the product.
capabilities.parses_untrusted_xml: Checkstyle, SpotBugs and JUnit report in XML, and this tool reads output it did not write. `_xml.parse_analyzer_xml` bounds the document and refuses any `<!ENTITY` or `<!DOCTYPE` before a parser sees it (D46); `_jvm_adapters` routes every parse through it.
capabilities.fetches_remote_urls: `tools/sonar_resolve.py` calls the SonarCloud API to record a justification against an issue. The host is a module constant, never taken from input.
capabilities.uses_nondeterministic_randomness: `tools/calibration/sampling_error.py` bootstraps the sampling distribution of the calibration fit. It is `random.Random(seed)` — seeded so the study reproduces — and it decides nothing at audit time.
